risk_note: RV1 (identity module only; no migration, no contract change). FU-ADMIN-DEVICES-SNAPSHOT (notices 6601, B1-02zz money r1 S2; 编排 10:01 / D10-968): adminListUserDevices read one page and the countAll through Promise.all on two pool connections, so a device revoked or added between them could give items and total from two moments (items one row, total 0). page() now opens a read-only REPEATABLE READ transaction and runs the two unchanged queries in order on one connection (snapshot taken at the first statement); the out-of-range page still gets the real total from its own count (no window count). Order, filters, fields, paging and permission unchanged; nothing written — READ ONLY also makes the database refuse a data-modifying CTE (spec-test r1 S2). Same pattern as WithdrawBlockedHits in app.module.ts. Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21; AWS runners off, D10-555).
